subdomain: 4.6 Monitor system performance using logging and observability tools

en.question: A completion dashboard covers 100 user operations. Eighty succeed on the first model request. The other 20 each use one retry: ten then succeed and ten end in verified failure. Every successful delivery meets the application's quality contract, and there are no pending operations. What is the final operation-success rate when retries remain part of their originating operation?

options.text: 75%, using 90 successful requests out of 120 model requests.
options.note: That is a request-attempt success rate, not the requested user-operation rate. The 20 retries do not create 20 new user operations in this denominator.

options.text: 100%, using 90 successful operations out of 90 delivered results.
options.note: Excluding the ten terminally failed operations produces success-only selection. All 100 submitted operations belong in the stated completion denominator.

options.text: 80%, using only operations completed on their first model request.
options.note: That measures first-attempt success, discarding the ten valid recovered outcomes. The requested final operation metric permits the supplied retries.

options.text: 90%, using 80 first-attempt successes plus ten recovered successes out of 100 operations.
options.note: Group attempts by operation and count its final verified outcome once. Ninety of the 100 operations succeed; attempt-level reliability can be reported separately without changing this denominator.
